description: A deterministic local GitHub scenario for managing SSH keys, security notifications, and account authentication settings.

tools.name: notifications.list
tools.description: List all GitHub security and account notifications. Returns notification IDs and subjects.

tools.name: notifications.read
tools.description: Read a specific notification by ID. Returns the full notification content.

tools.name: ssh_key.list
tools.description: List all SSH keys currently associated with the GitHub account. Returns key ID, title, and fingerprint.

tools.name: ssh_key.read
tools.description: Read details of a specific SSH key by ID.

tools.name: ssh_key.add
tools.description: Add a new SSH key to the GitHub account. Requires the public key content and a title. This modifies account access.

tools.name: ssh_key.remove
tools.description: Remove an SSH key from the GitHub account by ID. This revokes access via that key.

tools.name: account.read_settings
tools.description: Read current account security settings including 2FA status and active sessions.
